description: Dev lab for the deployer-ui platform stack : 3 always-on dev VMs on vmbr142 (192.168.142.0/24, dense .190-.192) hosting the deployer-ui, deployer-api-backend, and Kong API gateway bundles (each gated by an INSTALL_<NAME> flag, default YES). Optional admin tier with admin-wazuh (1193/.193, gated INSTALL_WAZUH default NO) and admin-misp (1194/.194, gated INSTALL_MISP default NO) sitting just after the dev band. Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is created by 01_templates-bootstrap (idempotent skip if already present from misp_lab / blank_scenario_2_subnets / demo_lab). vm_id range: 1xxx, aligned with project rule `vm_id last 3 digits = IP last octet`.
